name: Roamr: Every Mile Mapped
subtitle: Auto drive log, MPG, trip maps
promotionalText: Roamr spots your drives and maps them, records every ride, hike and run, and works out MPG for each vehicle from your fill-ups. Every mile on a night map.
description:
Roamr maps every mile you travel. Drives, bike rides, hikes, runs and walks are each saved with their route on a night map, and your fill-ups turn those drives into MPG for every vehicle you own.

EVERY MILE, MAPPED
Turn on drive detect and Roamr notices when a drive starts: one tap on the banner or notification records it, and it finishes on its own when you park. For rides, hikes, runs and walks, tap Start, lock your phone and go. Roamr keeps recording in the background and recovers the trip if the app gets closed.

FUEL AND VEHICLES
Log each fill-up with gallons and price. Roamr works out MPG from your odometer or from the drives it mapped between full tanks, for each vehicle, and shows what you spend on fuel each month. Stats shows every vehicle's average MPG and this month's spend at a glance.

NIGHT-MODE TRIP HISTORY
Every trip gets a card with its route, grouped by week and day with totals. Open one and the route fills the screen on a night map, with the key numbers on top and splits, speed and details in a sheet you pull up. Switch to day, satellite or hybrid any time. Filter by drive, ride, hike, run or walk.

ON THE ROAD
A big speedometer with the posted speed limit (from OpenStreetMap), and every drive saved with its start and end streets. Need directions? Search a place and Roamr guides you there turn by turn.

LIVE ON YOUR LOCK SCREEN
Distance, time, pace or speed and climb, live on screen and in a Live Activity. Voice splits call out each mile or kilometer.

GO TOGETHER
Start a group trip, send the invite link or join code, and everyone shows up live on one map. Each person's trip still lands in their own history.

STATS AND RECAPS
Weekly totals, personal records and all-time numbers, plus a monthly recap of miles, hours and your longest trip.

YOUR WORKOUTS AND HEART RATE
Roamr reads the workouts and heart rate your watch saves to Apple Health, so a run recorded on your wrist shows up with its heart rate. Your walks and hikes also show up under your tree hugs in Rootbound.

EXPORT
Share any route as a GPX file to the mapping or training app you already use.

APPLE WATCH, WIDGETS AND SIRI
Start a drive from your wrist and see it live, start mapping from a Home Screen widget or Control Center, log gas from a widget, or ask Siri to start tracking.

FREE AND PRO
Recording every trip, drive detect, History, Stats, the gas log, directions, the Watch app and joining a friend's group are free. Roamr Pro adds starting group trips and the monthly recap. Choose monthly or yearly (with a free first week for new subscribers) or a one-time lifetime unlock. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled; cancel anytime in Settings › your name › Subscriptions at least 24 hours before the period ends.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no analytics. Your trips live on your iPhone and in your own private iCloud. Drive detect uses low-power motion signals and only a few seconds of GPS when you seem to be driving. Your position is shared only with the people in a group trip you start or join, and only while it's on.

Watch the road, not your phone: keep your eyes on driving and follow local traffic laws and posted speed limits.
reviewNotes:
No account or sign-in.

What makes Roamr different: it maps every mile you travel in one place. Drive detect notices a drive starting and offers to record it (it never records without a tap), rides, hikes, runs and walks are one tap, every trip is kept in a night-map history, and fill-ups turn the mapped drives into MPG per vehicle (Stats › Fuel & vehicles).

To try it: on the Track tab pick Walk, Run, Hike, Ride or Drive and tap Start. In the Simulator, Features › Location › City Run makes a trip. History and Stats fill in as trips are saved.

Location: When In Use records the trip you start; Always keeps recording while the phone is locked and lets Roamr notice a drive starting so it can offer to record it (it never records without asking). Motion: tells walking, running, biking and driving apart. HealthKit: read-only, workouts and heart rate.

Go together (group trips): start one with the people button on the Track tab (Pro) or join with a code (free). Members' chosen name and live position are exchanged through the app's CloudKit public database only while the group is on.

Speed limits: road data is downloaded from OpenStreetMap in map tiles of about 4 km; no personal data is sent.

Directions: the Directions button on the Track map searches a place and routes with Apple Maps. Gas & MPG (Settings › Gas & MPG): fill-ups are stored like trips; "Use where I am" takes one location fix to find the nearest station with Apple Maps.

Pro: auto-renewable monthly (com.troydunn.roamr.pro.monthly) and yearly (com.troydunn.roamr.pro.yearly), each with a 1-week free trial as Apple's introductory offer, plus the one-time lifetime unlock (com.troydunn.roamr.pro). Settings › Roamr Pro shows the plans with Restore and Manage Subscription.
